```{r Libraries}
# packages required for analysis. I rely on the dplyr/tidyr a lot as I find the grouping (group_by,etc..) particularly helpful. I'd be familiar with those before using this script
# List of required packages
required_packages <- c("dplyr","asreml", "readxl", "tidyr",  "broom", "ggplot2", "reshape2","data.table", "viridis","grid", "gridExtra", "lattice","GGally", "tibble", "lme4")

# Function to install/load packages
install_and_load <- function(pkg) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Apply to all required packages
invisible(sapply(required_packages, install_and_load))
```

1. *NY Musgrave 2023 *

Loading and preparing data files
```{r loading files 05192026}
#import merged phenotype file 
ny_mus_pheno_23 <- read.csv("2023/MSI_data/output_files/Final_filtered_NY23_Musgrave_phenotypes_MSI.csv") # %>% # new filtered file used
  # select(-X) # remove index column

# need to convert into factors
ny_mus_pheno_23[, c("Range", "Rep","Germplasm","Plot", "Row")] <- lapply(ny_mus_pheno_23[, c("Range", "Rep","Germplasm","Plot", "Row")], as.factor)
colnames(ny_mus_pheno_23) 
str(ny_mus_pheno_23)


#import genotype file
grm_aa_ny<- read.csv("2022/genotype_data/grm_final.csv", sep = ",", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
grm_aa_ny  <- as.matrix(grm_aa_ny)
mean(diag(grm_aa_ny )) # 1
hist(diag(grm_aa_ny ))

grm_agh <- grm_aa_ny +diag(.0005,length(grm_aa_ny [,1]),length(grm_aa_ny [,1])) # adding 0.05 nugget/ridge to ensure matrix is strictly positive definite
grm_inverse <- solve(grm_agh)

```


```{r Run this, Adding scaled Yield as input to GNDVI, Mus23, 05192026}
# ============================================================
# STEP 0: ADD SCALED YIELD AS TERMINAL GNDVI PER HARVEST
# ============================================================

# Define mapping: yield → terminal GDD
yld_traits_mus23  <- paste0("sca_yld", 1:3)
gdd_targets_mus23 <- c(151, 200, 256) # add gdd of harvest dates, double check these are greater than or equal to last day of flight and less than next flight in next harvest window. LAST as 256 bcz there is already a flight of 255

# Add new GNDVI columns
for(i in 1:3){
  
  new_col <- paste0("GNDVI_", gdd_targets_mus23[i])
  
  # overwrite / create terminal GNDVI using scaled yield
  ny_mus_pheno_23[[new_col]] <- ny_mus_pheno_23[[yld_traits_mus23[i]]]
  
  cat("Assigned", yld_traits_mus23[i], "→", new_col, "\n")
}

# make sure after this step, three new columns are added. 
# ============================================================
# STEP 1: KEEP GNDVI + PIVOT LONG
# ============================================================

ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("NDVI_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("NDRE_"))

ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long <- pivot_longer(
  ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only,
  cols = starts_with("GNDVI_"),
  names_to = "GDD",
  names_prefix = "GNDVI_",
  values_to = "GNDVI")

ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long$GDD <- 
  as.numeric(ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long$GDD)


# ============================================================
# STEP 2: ASSIGN HARVEST WINDOWS (UNCHANGED)
# ============================================================

ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 151 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 152 & GDD <= 200 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 201 & GDD <= 256 ~ "Harvest3")) # 255 flight and 256 last yield (actual 255) cz they are on same date so to differentiate, made this diff.
```


```{r separate out each harvest window and then fit quadratic regression line 05192025}

# NOw lets plot
# First, assign harvest based on GDD
ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 151 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 152 & GDD <= 200 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 201 & GDD <= 256 ~ "Harvest3")) # 255 flight and 256 last yield (actual 255) cz they are on same date so to differentiate, made this diff.

# Plot with quadratic fit using geom_smooth
ggplot_quad_nor_23 <- ggplot(ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise, aes(x = GDD, y = GNDVI)) + # set up plot with GDD on x and GNDVi on y axis
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + # add points, alpha = 0.5 makes semitransparent points to see overlapping points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I(x^2), se = FALSE, color = "red") + # adds a quadratic regression line to the points. se = false removes shaded confidence interval around the line. 
  facet_wrap(~Harvest, scales = "free_x") + # separate panels for each harvest
  labs(x = "GDD", y = "GNDVI", title = "Quadratic Fit of GNDVI vs GDD by Harvest in Mus 22") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot_quad_nor_23
```

### PEE for thre harvests 151, 200, 256
    
```{r Combined chunk for harvest 1 using Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

#  Manage data file: First, assign harvest based on GDD
# first make harvest 2 only data file
ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 151 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 152 & GDD <= 200 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 201 & GDD <= 256 ~ "Harvest3")) # 255 flight and 256 last yield (actual 255) cz they are on same date so to differentiate, made this diff.
# Subset harvest 1
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1 <- ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest1") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$GDD)
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1 <- ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1[order(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$GDD_fac) # 125 136 144 150 151(for yld1)

# Build Legendre basis
unique_gdd_yld1 <- sort(unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$GDD))
unique_gdd_yld1 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld1)

 ######## fitting linear equation
M_yld1 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld1, 1) # for linear, 1
lambda_yld1 <- Legendre(1, gengler=TRUE) # for lin, 1

Phi_yld1 <- M_yld1 %*% t(lambda_yld1)
colnames(Phi_yld1) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin")
rownames(Phi_yld1) <- unique_gdd_yld1
Phi_yld1
ordLP_yld1 <- match(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld1))
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$LPInt_yld1 <- Phi_yld1[ordLP_yld1, "LPInt"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1$LPLin_yld1 <- Phi_yld1[ordLP_yld1, "LPLin"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1[1, 15:18]

# Fit RR model (harvest 1)
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

lp_mod_mus_23_yld1 <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed = GNDVI ~ 1 + at(GDD_fac):Rep , # fitting Rep effect
    random = ~ str(~ Germplasm:LPInt_yld1 + Germplasm:LPLin_yld1 , ~ us(2):vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse)) + str(~ Plot:LPInt_yld1 + Plot:LPLin_yld1, ~ us(2):id(Plot)), # # for quadratic, us(3)
    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_mus_gdd_harvest1)}

summary(lp_mod_mus_23_yld1)$varcomp
lp_mod_mus_23_yld1 <- update.asreml(lp_mod_mus_23_yld1, start = lp_mod_mus_23_yld1$gammas)

# Save random effects (BLUPs)
blups_yld1 <- lp_mod_mus_23_yld1$coefficients$random
blups_yld1


# ============================================================
# Extract spatial BLUPs from quadratic random regression
# ============================================================

# --- Convert BLUPs to data frame ---
blups_df_yld1 <- as.data.frame(blups_yld1) %>%
  rename(solution = 1)

# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld1$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld1))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld1 <- blups_df_yld1 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld1$", rownames(blups_df_yld1)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld1 <- blups_df_yld1 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld1$", rownames(blups_df_yld1)))

# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld1$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld1$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld1",
  "spa_lin_yld1")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_mus_spa_yld1 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_int_yld1  <- ny23_mus_spa_yld1$spa_int_yld1
ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld1  <- ny23_mus_spa_yld1$spa_lin_yld1


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld1

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
###
### then:

ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_151 <-
    1 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_int_yld1 +
    1.7320508 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld1 


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld1)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_mus_yld1_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld1 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_151,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_mus_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_pee)$varcomp




# 1st model: yield alone genetic model without spatial (autoregressive)
uni_ny23_mus_yld1 <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld1 ~ 1 + Row, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_mus_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1)$varcomp



# 2nd model: yield alone genetic model with spatial (autoregressive)
## Univariate with autoregressive spatial correction
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) +ar1(Range), # only row converged
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_mus_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa)$varcomp






# compare

# variance components
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_pee)$varcomp

# heritability
h2_no_spa  <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld1, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_no_spa # 0.28
h2_AR1     <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V4))
h2_AR1 # 0.32
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V5)) # if both
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa, heritA ~ V3 / (V3 + V4)) # if row only
h2_PEE     <-asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_pee, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_PEE # 0.50 


# visualize PEE too
 ## just PEE
ggplot(ny_mus_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_151)) + # !!!
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title=" PEE", fill="PEE") +
  theme_minimal()

# Visualize Residual - PEE to see what;s the pattern left. For that need to rescale residuals to PEE and then visualize these... (SAME SCALE NEEDED)

uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res <- residuals(uni_ny23_mus_yld1)
uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res
uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res <- scale(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res)
PEE_151 <- scale(ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_151)
plot(PEE_151)
uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res_pee_scaled <- uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res - PEE_151
uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res_pee_scaled
  # ggplot
ggplot(ny_mus_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=uni_ny23_mus_yld1_res_pee_scaled)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title="Residuals - PEE", fill="Residual") +
  theme_minimal()





# Get log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1)$loglik # 
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1)$aic
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld1)$aic

```

```{r Check model fit using correlation between model prediction and observed, Yld1, mus23, 05152026}
# Model fit = cor(y_hat, y) # y_hat = fitted model predictions and y = true phenotypic values

cor_fit_obs_base_yld1_mus23 <- cor(fitted(uni_ny23_mus_yld1), ny_mus_pheno_23$yld1, use = "complete.obs") 
cor_fit_obs_base_yld1_mus23 # 0.72
cor_fit_obs_spa_yld1_mus23 <- cor(fitted(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_spa), ny_mus_pheno_23$yld1, use = "complete.obs") 
cor_fit_obs_spa_yld1_mus23 # 0.81
cor_fit_obs_pee_yld1_mus23 <- cor(fitted(uni_ny23_mus_yld1_pee), ny_mus_pheno_23$yld1, use = "complete.obs") 
cor_fit_obs_pee_yld1_mus23 # 0.92
```

```{r GEER between two blocks (rep12 and rep34) for yld1 (only yield data) mus 2023, 05192026}
### =========================================================
### GEER using row-block subsets
### Musgrave NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld1)
###
### Strategy:
###   Since Rep is unavailable as an independent factor,
###   create pseudo-replicates using adjacent row blocks.
###
###   Block 1 = Rows 1 + 2
###   Block 2 = Rows 3 + 4
###
###   Fit models separately within each block:
###     1. Base
###     2. Spatial
###     3. PEE
###
###   Then correlate genomic BLUPs between blocks.
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

mus23_yld1_row12 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

mus23_yld1_row34 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))


### Check dimensions
dim(mus23_yld1_row12)
dim(mus23_yld1_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Ensure GRM inverse
### ---------------------------------------------------------

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE


### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_mus23_yld1_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld1_row12)

summary(base_mus23_yld1_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_mus23_yld1_row12 <- coef(base_mus23_yld1_row12)$random

blup_base_mus23_yld1_row12 <- blup_base_mus23_yld1_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld1_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_mus23_yld1_row12 <- blup_base_mus23_yld1_row12[,1]
names(g_base_mus23_yld1_row12) <- rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld1_row12)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_mus23_yld1_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld1_row34)

summary(base_mus23_yld1_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_mus23_yld1_row34 <- coef(base_mus23_yld1_row34)$random

blup_base_mus23_yld1_row34 <- blup_base_mus23_yld1_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld1_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_mus23_yld1_row34 <- blup_base_mus23_yld1_row34[,1]
names(g_base_mus23_yld1_row34) <- rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld1_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Base model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_base_mus23_yld1 <- intersect(names(g_base_mus23_yld1_row12), names(g_base_mus23_yld1_row34))
common_base_mus23_yld1
cor(g_base_mus23_yld1_row12[common_base_mus23_yld1], g_base_mus23_yld1_row34[common_base_mus23_yld1])




### =========================================================
### 4. SPATIAL MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_mus23_yld1_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld1_row12)

summary(spa_mus23_yld1_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12 <- coef(spa_mus23_yld1_row12)$random
blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12
blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

g_spa_mus23_yld1_row12 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12[,1]
names(g_spa_mus23_yld1_row12) <- rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row12)
g_spa_mus23_yld1_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_mus23_yld1_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld1_row34)

summary(spa_mus23_yld1_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row34 <- coef(spa_mus23_yld1_row34)$random

blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row34 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_spa_mus23_yld1_row34 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row34[,1]
names(g_spa_mus23_yld1_row34) <- rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld1_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Spatial model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_spa_mus23_yld1 <- intersect(names(g_spa_mus23_yld1_row12), names(g_spa_mus23_yld1_row34))

cor(g_spa_mus23_yld1_row12[common_spa_mus23_yld1], g_spa_mus23_yld1_row34[common_spa_mus23_yld1])


### =========================================================
### 5. PEE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_mus23_yld1_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_151,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld1_row12)

summary(pee_mus23_yld1_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row12 <- coef(pee_mus23_yld1_row12)$random

blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row12 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_mus23_yld1_row12 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row12[,1]
names(g_pee_mus23_yld1_row12) <- rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row12)
g_pee_mus23_yld1_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_mus23_yld1_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_151,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld1_row34)

summary(pee_mus23_yld1_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row34 <- coef(pee_mus23_yld1_row34)$random

blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row34 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_mus23_yld1_row34 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row34[,1]
names(g_pee_mus23_yld1_row34) <- rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld1_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: PEE model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

    cor(g_base_mus23_yld1_row12[common_base_mus23_yld1],
```

```{r Combined chunk for harvest2 using Quad Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

#  Manage data file: First, assign harvest based on GDD
# first make harvest 2 only data file
ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 151 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 152 & GDD <= 200 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 201 & GDD <= 256 ~ "Harvest3")) # 255 flight and 256 last yield (actual 255) cz they are on same date so to differentiate, made this diff.
# Subset harvest2
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2 <- ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest2") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$GDD)
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2 <- ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2[order(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$GDD_fac) # 152 156 164 166 172 177 179 186 198 200(for yld2)

# Build Legendre basis
unique_gdd_yld2 <- sort(unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$GDD))
unique_gdd_yld2 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld2)

 ######## fitting quadratic equation
M_yld2 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld2, 2) # for quad, 2
lambda_yld2 <- Legendre(2, gengler=TRUE) # for quad, 2

Phi_yld2 <- M_yld2 %*% t(lambda_yld2)
colnames(Phi_yld2) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin", "LPQuad")
rownames(Phi_yld2) <- unique_gdd_yld2
Phi_yld2
ordLP_yld2 <- match(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld2))
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$LPInt_yld2 <- Phi_yld2[ordLP_yld2, "LPInt"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$LPLin_yld2 <- Phi_yld2[ordLP_yld2, "LPLin"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2$LPQuad_yld2 <- Phi_yld2[ordLP_yld2, "LPQuad"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2[1, 15:19]

# Fit RR model (harvest 1)
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

lp_mod_mus_23_yld2 <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed = GNDVI ~ 1 + at(GDD_fac):Rep , # fitting Rep effect
    random = ~ str(~ Germplasm:LPInt_yld2 + Germplasm:LPLin_yld2 + Germplasm:LPQuad_yld2, ~ us(3):vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse)) + str(~ Plot:LPInt_yld2 + Plot:LPLin_yld2 + Plot:LPQuad_yld2, ~ us(3):id(Plot)), # # for quadratic, us(3)
    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_mus_gdd_harvest2)}

summary(lp_mod_mus_23_yld2)$varcomp
lp_mod_mus_23_yld2 <- update.asreml(lp_mod_mus_23_yld2, start = lp_mod_mus_23_yld2$gammas)

# Save random effects (BLUPs)
blups_yld2 <- lp_mod_mus_23_yld2$coefficients$random
blups_yld2


# ============================================================
# Extract spatial BLUPs from quadratic random regression
# ============================================================

# --- Convert BLUPs to data frame ---
blups_df_yld2 <- as.data.frame(blups_yld2) %>%
  rename(solution = 1)

# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld2$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld2))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))

### Quadratic BLUPs
BLUP_spa_quad_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPQuad_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))


# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld2$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld2$solution,
  BLUP_spa_quad_yld2$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld2",
  "spa_lin_yld2",
  "spa_quad_yld2")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_mus_spa_yld2 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_int_yld2  <- ny23_mus_spa_yld2$spa_int_yld2
ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld2  <- ny23_mus_spa_yld2$spa_lin_yld2
ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld2 <- ny23_mus_spa_yld2$spa_quad_yld2


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld2

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
### LPQuad = 2.2360679
###
### then:

ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_200 <-
    1 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_int_yld2 +
    1.7320508 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld2 +
    2.2360679 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld2


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld2)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_mus_yld2_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld2 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_200,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_mus_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_pee)$varcomp




# 1st model: yield alone genetic model without spatial (autoregressive)
uni_ny23_mus_yld2 <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld2 ~ 1 + Row, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_mus_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2)$varcomp



# 2nd model: yield alone genetic model with spatial (autoregressive)
## Univariate with autoregressive spatial correction
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

uni_ny23_mus_yld2_spa <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) +ar1(Range), # only row converged
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_mus_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_spa)$varcomp






# compare

# variance components
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_spa)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_pee)$varcomp

# heritability
h2_no_spa  <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld2, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_no_spa # 0.41
h2_AR1     <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V4))
h2_AR1 # 0.49
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V5)) # if both
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V3 / (V3 + V4)) # if row only
h2_PEE     <-asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_pee, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_PEE # 0.41


# visualize PEE too
 ## just PEE
ggplot(ny_mus_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_200)) + # !!!
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title=" PEE", fill="PEE") +
  theme_minimal()

# Visualize Residual - PEE to see what;s the pattern left. For that need to rescale residuals to PEE and then visualize these... (SAME SCALE NEEDED)

uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res <- residuals(uni_ny23_mus_yld2)
uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res
uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res <- scale(uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res)
PEE_200 <- scale(ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_200)
plot(PEE_200)
uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res_pee_scaled <- uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res - PEE_200
uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res_pee_scaled
  # ggplot
ggplot(ny_mus_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=uni_ny23_mus_yld2_res_pee_scaled)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title="Residuals - PEE", fill="Residual") +
  theme_minimal()





# Get log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2)$loglik # 
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2)$aic
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld2)$aic
```

```{r GEER between two blocks (rep12 and rep34) for yld2 (only yield data) mus 2023, 05192026}
### =========================================================
### GEER using row-block subsets
### Musgrave NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld2)
###
### Strategy:
###   Since Rep is unavailable as an independent factor,
###   create pseudo-replicates using adjacent row blocks.
###
###   Block 1 = Rows 1 + 2
###   Block 2 = Rows 3 + 4
###
###   Fit models separately within each block:
###     1. Base
###     2. Spatial
###     3. PEE
###
###   Then correlate genomic BLUPs between blocks.
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

mus23_yld2_row12 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

mus23_yld2_row34 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))


### Check dimensions
dim(mus23_yld2_row12)
dim(mus23_yld2_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Ensure GRM inverse
### ---------------------------------------------------------

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE


### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_mus23_yld2_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld2_row12)

summary(base_mus23_yld2_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_mus23_yld2_row12 <- coef(base_mus23_yld2_row12)$random

blup_base_mus23_yld2_row12 <- blup_base_mus23_yld2_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld2_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_mus23_yld2_row12 <- blup_base_mus23_yld2_row12[,1]
names(g_base_mus23_yld2_row12) <- rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld2_row12)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_mus23_yld2_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld2_row34)

summary(base_mus23_yld2_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_mus23_yld2_row34 <- coef(base_mus23_yld2_row34)$random

blup_base_mus23_yld2_row34 <- blup_base_mus23_yld2_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld2_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_mus23_yld2_row34 <- blup_base_mus23_yld2_row34[,1]
names(g_base_mus23_yld2_row34) <- rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld2_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Base model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_base_mus23_yld2 <- intersect(names(g_base_mus23_yld2_row12), names(g_base_mus23_yld2_row34))
common_base_mus23_yld2
cor(g_base_mus23_yld2_row12[common_base_mus23_yld2], g_base_mus23_yld2_row34[common_base_mus23_yld2])




### =========================================================
### 4. SPATIAL MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_mus23_yld2_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld2_row12)

summary(spa_mus23_yld2_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12 <- coef(spa_mus23_yld2_row12)$random
blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12
blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

g_spa_mus23_yld2_row12 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12[,1]
names(g_spa_mus23_yld2_row12) <- rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row12)
g_spa_mus23_yld2_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_mus23_yld2_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld2_row34)

summary(spa_mus23_yld2_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row34 <- coef(spa_mus23_yld2_row34)$random

blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row34 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_spa_mus23_yld2_row34 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row34[,1]
names(g_spa_mus23_yld2_row34) <- rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld2_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Spatial model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_spa_mus23_yld2 <- intersect(names(g_spa_mus23_yld2_row12), names(g_spa_mus23_yld2_row34))

cor(g_spa_mus23_yld2_row12[common_spa_mus23_yld2], g_spa_mus23_yld2_row34[common_spa_mus23_yld2])


### =========================================================
### 5. PEE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_mus23_yld2_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_200,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld2_row12)

summary(pee_mus23_yld2_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row12 <- coef(pee_mus23_yld2_row12)$random

blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row12 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_mus23_yld2_row12 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row12[,1]
names(g_pee_mus23_yld2_row12) <- rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row12)
g_pee_mus23_yld2_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_mus23_yld2_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_200,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld2_row34)

summary(pee_mus23_yld2_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row34 <- coef(pee_mus23_yld2_row34)$random

blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row34 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_mus23_yld2_row34 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row34[,1]
names(g_pee_mus23_yld2_row34) <- rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld2_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: PEE model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_pee_mus23_yld2 <- intersect(names(g_pee_mus23_yld2_row12), names(g_pee_mus23_yld2_row34))

cor( g_pee_mus23_yld2_row12[common_pee_mus23_yld2], g_pee_mus23_yld2_row34[common_pee_mus23_yld2])




### =========================================================
### 6. Final GEER summary table
### =========================================================

GEER_rowblock_results_mus23_yld2 <- data.frame(

  Model = c("Base", "Spatial", "PEE"),

  Pearson = c(
    cor(g_base_mus23_yld2_row12[common_base_mus23_yld2],
        g_base_mus23_yld2_row34[common_base_mus23_yld2]),

    cor(g_spa_mus23_yld2_row12[common_spa_mus23_yld2],
        g_spa_mus23_yld2_row34[common_spa_mus23_yld2]),

    cor(g_pee_mus23_yld2_row12[common_pee_mus23_yld2],
        g_pee_mus23_yld2_row34[common_pee_mus23_yld2])))

GEER_rowblock_results_mus23_yld2
```

############################ Harvest3: ############################ 


    
### PEE for thre harvests 151, 200, 256
    not quad
```{r Combined chunk for harvest3 using Quad Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

#  Manage data file: First, assign harvest based on GDD
# first make harvest 2 only data file
ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 151 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 152 & GDD <= 200 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 201 & GDD <= 256 ~ "Harvest3")) # 255 flight and 256 last yield (actual 255) cz they are on same date so to differentiate, made this diff.
# Subset harvest3
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3 <- ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest3") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD)
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3 <- ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3[order(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac) # 213 223 228 244 248 251 255 256(for yld3)

# Build Legendre basis
unique_gdd_yld3 <- sort(unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD))
unique_gdd_yld3 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld3)

 ######## fitting quadratic equation
M_yld3 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld3, 2) # for quad, 2
lambda_yld3 <- Legendre(2, gengler=TRUE) # for quad, 2

Phi_yld3 <- M_yld3 %*% t(lambda_yld3)
colnames(Phi_yld3) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin", "LPQuad")
rownames(Phi_yld3) <- unique_gdd_yld3
Phi_yld3
ordLP_yld3 <- match(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld3))
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$LPInt_yld3 <- Phi_yld3[ordLP_yld3, "LPInt"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$LPLin_yld3 <- Phi_yld3[ordLP_yld3, "LPLin"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$LPQuad_yld3 <- Phi_yld3[ordLP_yld3, "LPQuad"]
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3[1, 15:19]

# Fit RR model (harvest 1)
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

lp_mod_mus_23_yld3 <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed = GNDVI ~ 1 + at(GDD_fac):Rep , # fitting Rep effect
    random = ~ str(~ Germplasm:LPInt_yld3 + Germplasm:LPLin_yld3 + Germplasm:LPQuad_yld3, ~ us(3):vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse)) + str(~ Plot:LPInt_yld3 + Plot:LPLin_yld3 + Plot:LPQuad_yld3, ~ us(3):id(Plot)), # # for quadratic, us(3)
    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3)}

summary(lp_mod_mus_23_yld3)$varcomp
lp_mod_mus_23_yld3 <- update.asreml(lp_mod_mus_23_yld3, start = lp_mod_mus_23_yld3$gammas)

# Save random effects (BLUPs)
blups_yld3 <- lp_mod_mus_23_yld3$coefficients$random
blups_yld3


# ============================================================
# Extract spatial BLUPs from quadratic random regression
# ============================================================

# --- Convert BLUPs to data frame ---
blups_df_yld3 <- as.data.frame(blups_yld3) %>%
  rename(solution = 1)

# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld3$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld3))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld3 <- blups_df_yld3 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld3$", rownames(blups_df_yld3)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld3 <- blups_df_yld3 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld3$", rownames(blups_df_yld3)))

### Quadratic BLUPs
BLUP_spa_quad_yld3 <- blups_df_yld3 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPQuad_yld3$", rownames(blups_df_yld3)))


# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld3$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld3$solution,
  BLUP_spa_quad_yld3$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld3",
  "spa_lin_yld3",
  "spa_quad_yld3")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_mus_spa_yld3 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_int_yld3  <- ny23_mus_spa_yld3$spa_int_yld3
ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld3  <- ny23_mus_spa_yld3$spa_lin_yld3
ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld3 <- ny23_mus_spa_yld3$spa_quad_yld3


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld3

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
### LPQuad = 2.2360679
###
### then:

ny_mus_pheno_23$PEE_256 <-
    1 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_int_yld3 +
    1.7320508 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld3 +
    2.2360679 * ny_mus_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld3


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld3)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_mus_yld3_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld3 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_256,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_mus_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_mus_yld3_pee)$varcomp
```

```{r Combined chunk for harvest3 using Linear Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

    GDD >= 201 & GDD <= 256 ~ "Harvest3")) # 255 flight and 256 last yield (actual 255) cz they are on same date so to differentiate, made this diff.
# Subset harvest3
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3 <- ny_mus_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest3") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD)
ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3 <- ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3[order(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac) # 213 223 228 244 248 251 255 256(for yld3)

# Build Legendre basis

unique_gdd_yld3 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld3)

 ######## fitting linear equation
M_yld3 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld3, 1) # for lin, 1
lambda_yld3 <- Legendre(1, gengler=TRUE) # for lin, 1

Phi_yld3 <- M_yld3 %*% t(lambda_yld3)
colnames(Phi_yld3) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin")
rownames(Phi_yld3) <- unique_gdd_yld3
Phi_yld3
ordLP_yld3 <- match(ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld3))

ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3[1, 15:18]

    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_mus_gdd_harvest3)}

# Save random effects (BLUPs)

blups_yld3
```

```{r GEER between two blocks (rep12 and rep34) for yld3 (only yield data) mus 2023, 05192026}
### =========================================================
### GEER using row-block subsets
### Musgrave NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld3)
###
### Strategy:
###   Since Rep is unavailable as an independent factor,
###   create pseudo-replicates using adjacent row blocks.
###
###   Block 1 = Rows 1 + 2
###   Block 2 = Rows 3 + 4
###
###   Fit models separately within each block:
###     1. Base
###     2. Spatial
###     3. PEE
###
###   Then correlate genomic BLUPs between blocks.
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

mus23_yld3_row12 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

mus23_yld3_row34 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))


### Check dimensions
dim(mus23_yld3_row12)
dim(mus23_yld3_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Ensure GRM inverse
### ---------------------------------------------------------

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE


### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_mus23_yld3_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld3_row12)

summary(base_mus23_yld3_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_mus23_yld3_row12 <- coef(base_mus23_yld3_row12)$random

blup_base_mus23_yld3_row12 <- blup_base_mus23_yld3_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld3_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_mus23_yld3_row12 <- blup_base_mus23_yld3_row12[,1]
names(g_base_mus23_yld3_row12) <- rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld3_row12)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_mus23_yld3_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld3_row34)

summary(base_mus23_yld3_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_mus23_yld3_row34 <- coef(base_mus23_yld3_row34)$random

blup_base_mus23_yld3_row34 <- blup_base_mus23_yld3_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld3_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_mus23_yld3_row34 <- blup_base_mus23_yld3_row34[,1]
names(g_base_mus23_yld3_row34) <- rownames(blup_base_mus23_yld3_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Base model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_base_mus23_yld3 <- intersect(names(g_base_mus23_yld3_row12), names(g_base_mus23_yld3_row34))
common_base_mus23_yld3
cor(g_base_mus23_yld3_row12[common_base_mus23_yld3], g_base_mus23_yld3_row34[common_base_mus23_yld3])




### =========================================================
### 4. SPATIAL MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_mus23_yld3_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld3_row12)

summary(spa_mus23_yld3_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12 <- coef(spa_mus23_yld3_row12)$random
blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12
blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

g_spa_mus23_yld3_row12 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12[,1]
names(g_spa_mus23_yld3_row12) <- rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row12)
g_spa_mus23_yld3_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_mus23_yld3_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld3_row34)

summary(spa_mus23_yld3_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row34 <- coef(spa_mus23_yld3_row34)$random

blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row34 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_spa_mus23_yld3_row34 <- blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row34[,1]
names(g_spa_mus23_yld3_row34) <- rownames(blup_spa_mus23_yld3_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Spatial model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_spa_mus23_yld3 <- intersect(names(g_spa_mus23_yld3_row12), names(g_spa_mus23_yld3_row34))

cor(g_spa_mus23_yld3_row12[common_spa_mus23_yld3], g_spa_mus23_yld3_row34[common_spa_mus23_yld3])


### =========================================================
### 5. PEE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_mus23_yld3_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_256,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld3_row12)

summary(pee_mus23_yld3_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row12 <- coef(pee_mus23_yld3_row12)$random

blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row12 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_mus23_yld3_row12 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row12[,1]
names(g_pee_mus23_yld3_row12) <- rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row12)
g_pee_mus23_yld3_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_mus23_yld3_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_256,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = mus23_yld3_row34)

summary(pee_mus23_yld3_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row34 <- coef(pee_mus23_yld3_row34)$random

blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row34 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_mus23_yld3_row34 <- blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row34[,1]
names(g_pee_mus23_yld3_row34) <- rownames(blup_pee_mus23_yld3_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: PEE model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_pee_mus23_yld3 <- intersect(names(g_pee_mus23_yld3_row12), names(g_pee_mus23_yld3_row34))

cor( g_pee_mus23_yld3_row12[common_pee_mus23_yld3], g_pee_mus23_yld3_row34[common_pee_mus23_yld3])




### =========================================================
### 6. Final GEER summary table
### =========================================================

GEER_rowblock_results_mus23_yld3 <- data.frame(

  Model = c("Base", "Spatial", "PEE"),

  Pearson = c(
    cor(g_base_mus23_yld3_row12[common_base_mus23_yld3],
        g_base_mus23_yld3_row34[common_base_mus23_yld3]),

    cor(g_spa_mus23_yld3_row12[common_spa_mus23_yld3],
        g_spa_mus23_yld3_row34[common_spa_mus23_yld3]),

    cor(g_pee_mus23_yld3_row12[common_pee_mus23_yld3],
        g_pee_mus23_yld3_row34[common_pee_mus23_yld3])))

GEER_rowblock_results_mus23_yld3
```

```{r Validation of GEER results using all data base model, mus23 yld3, 05192026}

### =========================================================
### VALIDATION OF GEER RESULTS
### Musgrave NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld3)
###
### Goal:
###   Compare genomic BLUPs from:
###     1. Base model using all data
###     2. Spatial model using each block
###     3. PEE model using each block
###
### Validation:
###   Correlate block-specific BLUPs against
###   baseline genomic BLUPs from full dataset
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Ensure inverse GRM
### ---------------------------------------------------------

asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

mus23_yld3_row12 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

mus23_yld3_row34 <- ny_mus_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))



### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL USING ALL DATA
### =========================================================

mus23_yld3_base_all <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = ny_mus_pheno_23)

summary(mus23_yld3_base_all)$varcomp


### Extract genomic BLUPs

  ,
  drop = FALSE]

  rownames(mus23_yld3_gblup_base_all)
mus23_yld3_gblup_base_all

mus23_yld3_cor_spa



### PEE correlations

mus23_yld3_validation_results
```

1. *NY Snyder 2023 *

Loading and preparing data files
```{r loading files 05192026}
#import merged phenotype file 
ny_sny_pheno_23 <- read.csv("2023/MSI_data/output_files/Final_filtered_NY23_Snyder_phenotypes_MSI.csv") # %>% # new filtered file used
  # select(-X) # remove index column

# need to convert into factors
ny_sny_pheno_23[, c("Range", "Rep","Germplasm","Plot", "Row")] <- lapply(ny_sny_pheno_23[, c("Range", "Rep","Germplasm","Plot", "Row")], as.factor)
colnames(ny_sny_pheno_23) 
str(ny_sny_pheno_23)


#import genotype file
grm_aa_ny<- read.csv("2022/genotype_data/grm_final.csv", sep = ",", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
grm_aa_ny  <- as.matrix(grm_aa_ny)
mean(diag(grm_aa_ny )) # 1
hist(diag(grm_aa_ny ))

grm_agh <- grm_aa_ny +diag(.0005,length(grm_aa_ny [,1]),length(grm_aa_ny [,1])) # adding 0.05 nugget/ridge to ensure matrix is strictly positive definite
grm_inverse <- solve(grm_agh)

```


```{r Run this, Adding scaled Yield as input to GNDVI, sny23, 05192026}
# ============================================================
# STEP 0: ADD SCALED YIELD AS TERMINAL GNDVI PER HARVEST
# ============================================================

# Define mapping: yield → terminal GDD
yld_traits_sny23  <- paste0("sca_yld", 1:3)
gdd_targets_sny23 <- c(159, 201, 250) # add gdd of harvest dates, double check these are greater than or equal to last day of flight and less than next flight in next harvest window. LAST as 256 bcz there is already a flight of 255

# Add new GNDVI columns
for(i in 1:3){
  
  new_col <- paste0("GNDVI_", gdd_targets_sny23[i])
  
  # overwrite / create terminal GNDVI using scaled yield
  ny_sny_pheno_23[[new_col]] <- ny_sny_pheno_23[[yld_traits_sny23[i]]]
  
  cat("Assigned", yld_traits_sny23[i], "→", new_col, "\n")
}

# make sure after this step, three new columns are added. 
# ============================================================
# STEP 1: KEEP GNDVI + PIVOT LONG
# ============================================================

ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("NDVI_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("NDRE_"))

ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long <- pivot_longer(
  ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only,
  cols = starts_with("GNDVI_"),
  names_to = "GDD",
  names_prefix = "GNDVI_",
  values_to = "GNDVI")

ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long$GDD <- 
  as.numeric(ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long$GDD)


# ============================================================
# STEP 2: ASSIGN HARVEST WINDOWS (UNCHANGED)
# ============================================================

ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 159 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 160 & GDD <= 201 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 202 & GDD <= 250 ~ "Harvest3")) # check each window, flight and harvest gdd
```


```{r separate out each harvest window and then fit quadratic regression line 05192025}

# NOw lets plot
# First, assign harvest based on GDD
ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 159 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 160 & GDD <= 201 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 202 & GDD <= 250 ~ "Harvest3")) # check each window, flight and harvest gdd

# Plot with quadratic fit using geom_smooth
ggplot_quad_nor_23 <- ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise, aes(x = GDD, y = GNDVI)) + # set up plot with GDD on x and GNDVi on y axis
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + # add points, alpha = 0.5 makes semitransparent points to see overlapping points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I(x^2), se = FALSE, color = "red") + # adds a quadratic regression line to the points. se = false removes shaded confidence interval around the line. 
  facet_wrap(~Harvest, scales = "free_x") + # separate panels for each harvest
  labs(x = "GDD", y = "GNDVI", title = "Quadratic Fit of GNDVI vs GDD by Harvest in Sny 23") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot_quad_nor_23
```

############################ Harvest1: ############################ 


    
### PEE for thre harvests 159, 201, 250

- linear fits better

```{r Combined chunk for harvest 1 using Linear Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

#  Manage data file: First, assign harvest based on GDD
# first make harvest 2 only data file
ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 159 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 160 & GDD <= 201 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 202 & GDD <= 250 ~ "Harvest3")) # check each window, flight and harvest gdd
# Subset harvest 1
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1 <- ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest1") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$GDD)
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1 <- ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1[order(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$GDD_fac) # 125 136 144 150 151(for yld1)

# Build Legendre basis
unique_gdd_yld1 <- sort(unique(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$GDD))
unique_gdd_yld1 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld1)

 ######## fitting linear equation
M_yld1 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld1, 1) # for linear, 1
lambda_yld1 <- Legendre(1, gengler=TRUE) # for lin, 1

Phi_yld1 <- M_yld1 %*% t(lambda_yld1)
colnames(Phi_yld1) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin")
rownames(Phi_yld1) <- unique_gdd_yld1
Phi_yld1
ordLP_yld1 <- match(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld1))
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$LPInt_yld1 <- Phi_yld1[ordLP_yld1, "LPInt"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1$LPLin_yld1 <- Phi_yld1[ordLP_yld1, "LPLin"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1[1, 15:18]

# Fit RR model (harvest 1)
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

lp_mod_sny_23_yld1 <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed = GNDVI ~ 1 + at(GDD_fac):Rep , # fitting Rep effect
    random = ~ str(~ Germplasm:LPInt_yld1 + Germplasm:LPLin_yld1 , ~ us(2):vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse)) + str(~ Plot:LPInt_yld1 + Plot:LPLin_yld1, ~ us(2):id(Plot)), # # for quadratic, us(3)
    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_sny_gdd_harvest1)}

summary(lp_mod_sny_23_yld1)$varcomp
# lp_mod_sny_23_yld1 <- update.asreml(lp_mod_sny_23_yld1, start = lp_mod_sny_23_yld1$gammas)

# Save random effects (BLUPs)
blups_yld1 <- lp_mod_sny_23_yld1$coefficients$random
blups_yld1


# ============================================================
# Extract spatial BLUPs from quadratic random regression
# ============================================================

# --- Convert BLUPs to data frame ---
blups_df_yld1 <- as.data.frame(blups_yld1) %>%
  rename(solution = 1)

# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld1$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld1))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld1 <- blups_df_yld1 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld1$", rownames(blups_df_yld1)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld1 <- blups_df_yld1 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld1$", rownames(blups_df_yld1)))

# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld1$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld1$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld1",
  "spa_lin_yld1")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_sny_spa_yld1 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld1)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld1  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld1$spa_int_yld1
ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld1  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld1$spa_lin_yld1


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld1

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
###
### then:

ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_159 <-
    1 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld1 +
    1.7320508 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld1 


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld1)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_sny_yld1_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld1 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_159,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_sny_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_pee)$varcomp




# 1st model: yield alone genetic model without spatial (autoregressive)
uni_ny23_sny_yld1 <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld1 ~ 1 + Row, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1)$varcomp



# 2nd model: yield alone genetic model with spatial (autoregressive)
## Univariate with autoregressive spatial correction
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

uni_ny23_sny_yld1_spa <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) +ar1(Range), # only row converged
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_spa)$varcomp






# compare

# variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_spa)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_pee)$varcomp

# heritability
h2_no_spa  <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld1, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_no_spa # 0.22
h2_AR1     <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V4))
h2_AR1 # 0.45
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V5)) # if both
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_spa, heritA ~ V3 / (V3 + V4)) # if row only
h2_PEE     <-asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_pee, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_PEE # 0.33 


# visualize PEE too
 ## just PEE
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_159)) + # !!!
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title=" PEE", fill="PEE") +
  theme_minimal()

# Visualize Residual - PEE to see what;s the pattern left. For that need to rescale residuals to PEE and then visualize these... (SAME SCALE NEEDED)

uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res <- residuals(uni_ny23_sny_yld1)
uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res
uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res <- scale(uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res)
PEE_159 <- scale(ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_159)
plot(PEE_159)
uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res_pee_scaled <- uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res - PEE_159
uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res_pee_scaled
  # ggplot
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=uni_ny23_sny_yld1_res_pee_scaled)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title="Residuals - PEE", fill="Residual") +
  theme_minimal()





# Get log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1)$loglik # 
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1)$aic
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld1)$aic
```

```{r GEER between two blocks (rep12 and rep34) for yld1 (only yield data) sny 2023, 05192026}
### =========================================================
### GEER using row-block subsets
### Snyder NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld1)
###
### Strategy:
###   Since Rep is unavailable as an independent factor,
###   create pseudo-replicates using adjacent row blocks.
###
###   Block 1 = Rows 1 + 2
###   Block 2 = Rows 3 + 4
###
###   Fit models separately within each block:
###     1. Base
###     2. Spatial
###     3. PEE
###
###   Then correlate genomic BLUPs between blocks.
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

sny23_yld1_row12 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

sny23_yld1_row34 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))


### Check dimensions
dim(sny23_yld1_row12)
dim(sny23_yld1_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Ensure GRM inverse
### ---------------------------------------------------------

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE


### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_sny23_yld1_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld1_row12)

summary(base_sny23_yld1_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_sny23_yld1_row12 <- coef(base_sny23_yld1_row12)$random

blup_base_sny23_yld1_row12 <- blup_base_sny23_yld1_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld1_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_sny23_yld1_row12 <- blup_base_sny23_yld1_row12[,1]
names(g_base_sny23_yld1_row12) <- rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld1_row12)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_sny23_yld1_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld1_row34)

summary(base_sny23_yld1_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_sny23_yld1_row34 <- coef(base_sny23_yld1_row34)$random

blup_base_sny23_yld1_row34 <- blup_base_sny23_yld1_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld1_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_sny23_yld1_row34 <- blup_base_sny23_yld1_row34[,1]
names(g_base_sny23_yld1_row34) <- rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld1_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Base model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_base_sny23_yld1 <- intersect(names(g_base_sny23_yld1_row12), names(g_base_sny23_yld1_row34))
common_base_sny23_yld1
cor(g_base_sny23_yld1_row12[common_base_sny23_yld1], g_base_sny23_yld1_row34[common_base_sny23_yld1])




### =========================================================
### 4. SPATIAL MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_sny23_yld1_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld1_row12)

summary(spa_sny23_yld1_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12 <- coef(spa_sny23_yld1_row12)$random
blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12
blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

g_spa_sny23_yld1_row12 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12[,1]
names(g_spa_sny23_yld1_row12) <- rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row12)
g_spa_sny23_yld1_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_sny23_yld1_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld1_row34)

summary(spa_sny23_yld1_row34)$varcomp

  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_spa_sny23_yld1_row34 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row34[,1]
names(g_spa_sny23_yld1_row34) <- rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld1_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Spatial model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_spa_sny23_yld1 <- intersect(names(g_spa_sny23_yld1_row12), names(g_spa_sny23_yld1_row34))

cor(g_spa_sny23_yld1_row12[common_spa_sny23_yld1], g_spa_sny23_yld1_row34[common_spa_sny23_yld1])


### =========================================================
### 5. PEE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_sny23_yld1_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1  + PEE_159,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),

summary(pee_sny23_yld1_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row12 <- coef(pee_sny23_yld1_row12)$random

blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row12 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_sny23_yld1_row12 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row12[,1]
names(g_pee_sny23_yld1_row12) <- rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row12)
g_pee_sny23_yld1_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_sny23_yld1_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld1 ~ 1  +  PEE_159,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld1_row34)

summary(pee_sny23_yld1_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row34 <- coef(pee_sny23_yld1_row34)$random

blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row34 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_sny23_yld1_row34 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row34[,1]
names(g_pee_sny23_yld1_row34) <- rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld1_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: PEE model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_pee_sny23_yld1 <- intersect(names(g_pee_sny23_yld1_row12), names(g_pee_sny23_yld1_row34))

cor( g_pee_sny23_yld1_row12[common_pee_sny23_yld1], g_pee_sny23_yld1_row34[common_pee_sny23_yld1])




### =========================================================
### 6. Final GEER summary table
### =========================================================

GEER_rowblock_results_sny23_yld1 <- data.frame(

  Model = c("Base", "Spatial", "PEE"),

  Pearson = c(
    cor(g_base_sny23_yld1_row12[common_base_sny23_yld1],
        g_base_sny23_yld1_row34[common_base_sny23_yld1]),

    cor(g_spa_sny23_yld1_row12[common_spa_sny23_yld1],
        g_spa_sny23_yld1_row34[common_spa_sny23_yld1]),

    cor(g_pee_sny23_yld1_row12[common_pee_sny23_yld1],
        g_pee_sny23_yld1_row34[common_pee_sny23_yld1])))

GEER_rowblock_results_sny23_yld1
```

```{r Combined chunk for harvest2 using Quad Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

#  Manage data file: First, assign harvest based on GDD
# first make harvest 2 only data file
ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 159 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 160 & GDD <= 201 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 202 & GDD <= 250 ~ "Harvest3")) # check each window, flight and harvest gdd
# Subset harvest2
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2 <- ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest2") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$GDD)
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2 <- ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2[order(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$GDD_fac) # 164 166 172 178 184 187 193 198 201(for yld2)

# Build Legendre basis
unique_gdd_yld2 <- sort(unique(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$GDD))
unique_gdd_yld2 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld2)

 ######## fitting quadratic equation
M_yld2 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld2, 2) # for quad, 2
lambda_yld2 <- Legendre(2, gengler=TRUE) # for quad, 2

Phi_yld2 <- M_yld2 %*% t(lambda_yld2)
colnames(Phi_yld2) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin", "LPQuad")
rownames(Phi_yld2) <- unique_gdd_yld2
Phi_yld2
ordLP_yld2 <- match(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld2))
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$LPInt_yld2 <- Phi_yld2[ordLP_yld2, "LPInt"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$LPLin_yld2 <- Phi_yld2[ordLP_yld2, "LPLin"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2$LPQuad_yld2 <- Phi_yld2[ordLP_yld2, "LPQuad"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2[1, 15:19]

# Fit RR model (harvest 1)
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

lp_mod_sny_23_yld2 <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed = GNDVI ~ 1 + at(GDD_fac):Rep , # fitting Rep effect
    random = ~ str(~ Germplasm:LPInt_yld2 + Germplasm:LPLin_yld2 + Germplasm:LPQuad_yld2, ~ us(3):vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse)) + str(~ Plot:LPInt_yld2 + Plot:LPLin_yld2 + Plot:LPQuad_yld2, ~ us(3):id(Plot)), # # for quadratic, us(3)
    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_sny_gdd_harvest2)}

summary(lp_mod_sny_23_yld2)$varcomp
lp_mod_sny_23_yld2 <- update.asreml(lp_mod_sny_23_yld2, start = lp_mod_sny_23_yld2$gammas)

# Save random effects (BLUPs)
blups_yld2 <- lp_mod_sny_23_yld2$coefficients$random
blups_yld2


# ============================================================
# Extract spatial BLUPs from quadratic random regression
# ============================================================

# --- Convert BLUPs to data frame ---
blups_df_yld2 <- as.data.frame(blups_yld2) %>%
  rename(solution = 1)

# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld2$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld2))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))

### Quadratic BLUPs
BLUP_spa_quad_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPQuad_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))


# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld2$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld2$solution,
  BLUP_spa_quad_yld2$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld2",
  "spa_lin_yld2",
  "spa_quad_yld2")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_sny_spa_yld2 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld2  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld2$spa_int_yld2
ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld2  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld2$spa_lin_yld2
ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld2 <- ny23_sny_spa_yld2$spa_quad_yld2


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld2

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
### LPQuad = 2.2360679
###
### then:

ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_201 <-
    1 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld2 +
    1.7320508 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld2 +
    2.2360679 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld2


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld2)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld2 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_201,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_sny_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee)$varcomp




# 1st model: yield alone genetic model without spatial (autoregressive)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2 <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld2 ~ 1 + Row, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$varcomp



# 2nd model: yield alone genetic model with spatial (autoregressive)
## Univariate with autoregressive spatial correction
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) +ar1(Range), # only row converged
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa)$varcomp






# compare

# variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee)$varcomp

# heritability
h2_no_spa  <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_no_spa # 0.47
h2_AR1     <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V4))
h2_AR1 # 0.52
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V5)) # if both
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V3 / (V3 + V4)) # if row only
h2_PEE     <-asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_PEE # 0.46


# visualize PEE too
 ## just PEE
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_201)) + # !!!
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title=" PEE", fill="PEE") +
  theme_minimal()

# Visualize Residual - PEE to see what;s the pattern left. For that need to rescale residuals to PEE and then visualize these... (SAME SCALE NEEDED)

uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res <- residuals(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res <- scale(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res)
PEE_201 <- scale(ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_201)
plot(PEE_201)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res_pee_scaled <- uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res - PEE_201
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res_pee_scaled
  # ggplot
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res_pee_scaled)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title="Residuals - PEE", fill="Residual") +
  theme_minimal()





# Get log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$loglik # 
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$aic
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$aic
```
