```{r Combined chunk for harvest2 using Linear Random Regression 05192026}
# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld2$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld2))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld2 <- blups_df_yld2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld2$", rownames(blups_df_yld2)))


# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld2$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld2$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld2",
  "spa_lin_yld2")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_sny_spa_yld2 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld2)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld2  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld2$spa_int_yld2
ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld2  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld2$spa_lin_yld2


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld2

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
###
### then:

ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_201 <-
    1 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld2 +
    1.7320508 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld2 


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld2)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld2 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_201,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_sny_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee)$varcomp




# 1st model: yield alone genetic model without spatial (autoregressive)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2 <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld2 ~ 1 + Row, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$varcomp



# 2nd model: yield alone genetic model with spatial (autoregressive)
## Univariate with autoregressive spatial correction
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) +ar1(Range), # only row converged
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa)$varcomp






# compare

# variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee)$varcomp

# heritability
h2_no_spa  <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_no_spa # 0.41
h2_AR1     <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V4))
h2_AR1 # 0.49
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V5)) # if both
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_spa, heritA ~ V3 / (V3 + V4)) # if row only
h2_PEE     <-asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_pee, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_PEE # 0.43


# visualize PEE too
 ## just PEE
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_201)) + # !!!
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title=" PEE", fill="PEE") +
  theme_minimal()

# Visualize Residual - PEE to see what;s the pattern left. For that need to rescale residuals to PEE and then visualize these... (SAME SCALE NEEDED)

uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res <- residuals(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res <- scale(uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res)
PEE_201 <- scale(ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_201)
plot(PEE_201)
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res_pee_scaled <- uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res - PEE_201
uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res_pee_scaled
  # ggplot
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=uni_ny23_sny_yld2_res_pee_scaled)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="white", high="red", midpoint=0) +
  labs(title="Residuals - PEE", fill="Residual") +
  theme_minimal()





# Get log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$loglik # 
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$aic
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld2)$aic
```

```{r GEER between two blocks (rep12 and rep34) for yld2 (only yield data) sny 2023, 05192026}
### =========================================================
### GEER using row-block subsets
### Snyder NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld2)
###
### Strategy:
###   Since Rep is unavailable as an independent factor,
###   create pseudo-replicates using adjacent row blocks.
###
###   Block 1 = Rows 1 + 2
###   Block 2 = Rows 3 + 4
###
###   Fit models separately within each block:
###     1. Base
###     2. Spatial
###     3. PEE
###
###   Then correlate genomic BLUPs between blocks.
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

sny23_yld2_row12 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

sny23_yld2_row34 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))


### Check dimensions
dim(sny23_yld2_row12)
dim(sny23_yld2_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Ensure GRM inverse
### ---------------------------------------------------------

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE


### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_sny23_yld2_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld2_row12)

summary(base_sny23_yld2_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_sny23_yld2_row12 <- coef(base_sny23_yld2_row12)$random

blup_base_sny23_yld2_row12 <- blup_base_sny23_yld2_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld2_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_sny23_yld2_row12 <- blup_base_sny23_yld2_row12[,1]
names(g_base_sny23_yld2_row12) <- rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld2_row12)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_sny23_yld2_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld2_row34)

summary(base_sny23_yld2_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_sny23_yld2_row34 <- coef(base_sny23_yld2_row34)$random

blup_base_sny23_yld2_row34 <- blup_base_sny23_yld2_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld2_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_sny23_yld2_row34 <- blup_base_sny23_yld2_row34[,1]
names(g_base_sny23_yld2_row34) <- rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld2_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Base model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_base_sny23_yld2 <- intersect(names(g_base_sny23_yld2_row12), names(g_base_sny23_yld2_row34))
common_base_sny23_yld2
cor(g_base_sny23_yld2_row12[common_base_sny23_yld2], g_base_sny23_yld2_row34[common_base_sny23_yld2])




### =========================================================
### 4. SPATIAL MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_sny23_yld2_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld2_row12)

summary(spa_sny23_yld2_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12 <- coef(spa_sny23_yld2_row12)$random
blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12
blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

g_spa_sny23_yld2_row12 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12[,1]
names(g_spa_sny23_yld2_row12) <- rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row12)
g_spa_sny23_yld2_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_sny23_yld2_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld2_row34)

summary(spa_sny23_yld2_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row34 <- coef(spa_sny23_yld2_row34)$random

blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row34 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_spa_sny23_yld2_row34 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row34[,1]
names(g_spa_sny23_yld2_row34) <- rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld2_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Spatial model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_spa_sny23_yld2 <- intersect(names(g_spa_sny23_yld2_row12), names(g_spa_sny23_yld2_row34))

cor(g_spa_sny23_yld2_row12[common_spa_sny23_yld2], g_spa_sny23_yld2_row34[common_spa_sny23_yld2])


### =========================================================
### 5. PEE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_sny23_yld2_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_201,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld2_row12)

summary(pee_sny23_yld2_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row12 <- coef(pee_sny23_yld2_row12)$random

blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row12 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_sny23_yld2_row12 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row12[,1]
names(g_pee_sny23_yld2_row12) <- rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row12)
g_pee_sny23_yld2_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_sny23_yld2_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld2 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_201,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld2_row34)

summary(pee_sny23_yld2_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row34 <- coef(pee_sny23_yld2_row34)$random

blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row34 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_sny23_yld2_row34 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row34[,1]
names(g_pee_sny23_yld2_row34) <- rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld2_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: PEE model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_pee_sny23_yld2 <- intersect(names(g_pee_sny23_yld2_row12), names(g_pee_sny23_yld2_row34))

cor( g_pee_sny23_yld2_row12[common_pee_sny23_yld2], g_pee_sny23_yld2_row34[common_pee_sny23_yld2])




### =========================================================
### 6. Final GEER summary table
### =========================================================

GEER_rowblock_results_sny23_yld2 <- data.frame(

  Model = c("Base", "Spatial", "PEE"),

  Pearson = c(
    cor(g_base_sny23_yld2_row12[common_base_sny23_yld2],
        g_base_sny23_yld2_row34[common_base_sny23_yld2]),

    cor(g_spa_sny23_yld2_row12[common_spa_sny23_yld2],
        g_spa_sny23_yld2_row34[common_spa_sny23_yld2]),

    cor(g_pee_sny23_yld2_row12[common_pee_sny23_yld2],
        g_pee_sny23_yld2_row34[common_pee_sny23_yld2])))

GEER_rowblock_results_sny23_yld2
```

```{r Combined chunk for harvest3 using Quad Random Regression 05192026}
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)
# ---------- PART 0: Manange data file -----------

#  Manage data file: First, assign harvest based on GDD
# first make harvest 2 only data file
ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise <- 
  ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long %>%
  mutate(Harvest = case_when(
    GDD >= 60  & GDD <= 159 ~ "Harvest1",
    GDD >= 160 & GDD <= 201 ~ "Harvest2",
    GDD >= 202 & GDD <= 250 ~ "Harvest3")) # check each window, flight and harvest gdd
# Subset harvest3
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3 <- ny_sny_pheno_23_gndvi_only_long_harvestwise %>%
  filter(Harvest == "Harvest3") # !!! capital H

# create factor + numeric GDD
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac <- as.factor(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$GDD)
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3 <- ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3[order(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac),]

unique(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$GDD_fac) # 213 223 228 244 248 251 255 256(for yld3)

# Build Legendre basis
unique_gdd_yld3 <- sort(unique(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$GDD))
unique_gdd_yld3 <- as.numeric(unique_gdd_yld3)

 ######## fitting quadratic equation
M_yld3 <- stdtime(unique_gdd_yld3, 2) # for quad, 2
lambda_yld3 <- Legendre(2, gengler=TRUE) # for quad, 2

Phi_yld3 <- M_yld3 %*% t(lambda_yld3)
colnames(Phi_yld3) <- c("LPInt", "LPLin", "LPQuad")
rownames(Phi_yld3) <- unique_gdd_yld3
Phi_yld3
ordLP_yld3 <- match(ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$GDD, rownames(Phi_yld3))
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$LPInt_yld3 <- Phi_yld3[ordLP_yld3, "LPInt"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$LPLin_yld3 <- Phi_yld3[ordLP_yld3, "LPLin"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3$LPQuad_yld3 <- Phi_yld3[ordLP_yld3, "LPQuad"]
ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3[1, 15:19]

# Fit RR model (harvest 1)
asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

lp_mod_sny_23_yld3 <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed = GNDVI ~ 1 + at(GDD_fac):Rep , # fitting Rep effect
    random = ~ str(~ Germplasm:LPInt_yld3 + Germplasm:LPLin_yld3 + Germplasm:LPQuad_yld3, ~ us(3):vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse)) + str(~ Plot:LPInt_yld3 + Plot:LPLin_yld3 + Plot:LPQuad_yld3, ~ us(3):id(Plot)), # # for quadratic, us(3)
    residual = ~ dsum(~ units | GDD_fac),
    data = ny23_sny_gdd_harvest3)}

summary(lp_mod_sny_23_yld3)$varcomp
lp_mod_sny_23_yld3 <- update.asreml(lp_mod_sny_23_yld3, start = lp_mod_sny_23_yld3$gammas)

# Save random effects (BLUPs)
blups_yld3 <- lp_mod_sny_23_yld3$coefficients$random
blups_yld3


# ============================================================
# Extract spatial BLUPs from quadratic random regression
# ============================================================

# --- Convert BLUPs to data frame ---
blups_df_yld3 <- as.data.frame(blups_yld3) %>%
  rename(solution = 1)

# Simplify term names
blups_df_yld3$term <- gsub(":.*", "", rownames(blups_df_yld3))


# ============================================================
#  Extract plot-level random regression coefficients
# ============================================================

### Intercept BLUPs
BLUP_spa_int_yld3 <- blups_df_yld3 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPInt_yld3$", rownames(blups_df_yld3)))

### Linear BLUPs
BLUP_spa_lin_yld3 <- blups_df_yld3 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPLin_yld3$", rownames(blups_df_yld3)))

### Quadratic BLUPs
BLUP_spa_quad_yld3 <- blups_df_yld3 %>%
  filter(grepl("^Plot_.*LPQuad_yld3$", rownames(blups_df_yld3)))


# ============================================================
# 2. Combine spatial coefficients
# ============================================================

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3 <- cbind(
  BLUP_spa_int_yld3$solution,
  BLUP_spa_lin_yld3$solution,
  BLUP_spa_quad_yld3$solution)

colnames(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3) <- c(
  "spa_int_yld3",
  "spa_lin_yld3",
  "spa_quad_yld3")

spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3


# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to data frame
# ============================================================

ny23_sny_spa_yld3 <- as.data.frame(spa_BLUP_matrix_yld3)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add spatial coefficients to phenotype data
# ============================================================

ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld3  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld3$spa_int_yld3
ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld3  <- ny23_sny_spa_yld3$spa_lin_yld3
ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld3 <- ny23_sny_spa_yld3$spa_quad_yld3


# ============================================================
# 5. Construct Permanent Environmental Effect (PEE)
# ============================================================

### Extract Legendre coefficients for target GDD/time
Phi_yld3

### Example:
### If final GDD corresponds to:
### LPInt  = 1
### LPLin  = 1.7320508
### LPQuad = 2.2360679
###
### then:

ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_250 <-
    1 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_int_yld3 +
    1.7320508 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_lin_yld3 +
    2.2360679 * ny_sny_pheno_23$spa_quad_yld3


# ---------- Step 2: Fit PEE's as fixed regressor on a yield model with spatial correction ----------

# Fit single-trait model for yield (yld3)
# Spatial effects are included as fixed covariates (PEE correction)
uni_ny23_sny_yld3_pee <- { 
  attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(
    fixed   = yld3 ~ 1 + Row + PEE_250,   # PEE as fixed regressors
    random  = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),         # genomic effect
    residual= ~ id(units),
    data    = ny_sny_pheno_23)}


# Extract variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_pee)$varcomp




# 1st model: yield alone genetic model without spatial (autoregressive)
uni_ny23_sny_yld3 <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld3 ~ 1 + Row, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld3)$varcomp



# 2nd model: yield alone genetic model with spatial (autoregressive)

uni_ny23_sny_yld3_spa <- { 
    attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE
  asreml(fixed = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep, #row effect as fixed
         random = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) +ar1(Range), # only row converged
         residual = ~ id(units),
         data = ny_sny_pheno_23)}
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_spa)$varcomp






# compare

# variance components
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld3)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_spa)$varcomp
summary(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_pee)$varcomp

# heritability
h2_no_spa  <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld3, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_no_spa # 0.41
h2_AR1     <- asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V4))
h2_AR1 # 0.49
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_spa, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V5)) # if both
# asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_spa, heritA ~ V3 / (V3 + V4)) # if row only
h2_PEE     <-asreml::vpredict(uni_ny23_sny_yld3_pee, heritA ~ V1 / (V1 + V2))
h2_PEE # 0.41


# visualize PEE too
 ## just PEE
ggplot(ny_sny_pheno_23, aes(x=Row, y=Range, fill=ny_sny_pheno_23$PEE_250)) + # !!!
```

```{r GEER between two blocks (rep12 and rep34) for yld3 (only yield data) sny 2023, 05192026}
### =========================================================
### GEER using row-block subsets
### Snyder NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld3)
###
### Strategy:
###   Since Rep is unavailable as an independent factor,
###   create pseudo-replicates using adjacent row blocks.
###
###   Block 1 = Rows 1 + 2
###   Block 2 = Rows 3 + 4
###
###   Fit models separately within each block:
###     1. Base
###     2. Spatial
###     3. PEE
###
###   Then correlate genomic BLUPs between blocks.
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

sny23_yld3_row12 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

sny23_yld3_row34 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))


### Check dimensions
dim(sny23_yld3_row12)
dim(sny23_yld3_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Ensure GRM inverse
### ---------------------------------------------------------

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE


### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_sny23_yld3_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld3_row12)

summary(base_sny23_yld3_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_sny23_yld3_row12 <- coef(base_sny23_yld3_row12)$random

blup_base_sny23_yld3_row12 <- blup_base_sny23_yld3_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld3_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_sny23_yld3_row12 <- blup_base_sny23_yld3_row12[,1]
names(g_base_sny23_yld3_row12) <- rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld3_row12)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

base_sny23_yld3_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld3_row34)

summary(base_sny23_yld3_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_base_sny23_yld3_row34 <- coef(base_sny23_yld3_row34)$random

blup_base_sny23_yld3_row34 <- blup_base_sny23_yld3_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld3_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_base_sny23_yld3_row34 <- blup_base_sny23_yld3_row34[,1]
names(g_base_sny23_yld3_row34) <- rownames(blup_base_sny23_yld3_row34)


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Base model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_base_sny23_yld3 <- intersect(names(g_base_sny23_yld3_row12), names(g_base_sny23_yld3_row34))
common_base_sny23_yld3
cor(g_base_sny23_yld3_row12[common_base_sny23_yld3], g_base_sny23_yld3_row34[common_base_sny23_yld3])




### =========================================================
### 4. SPATIAL MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_sny23_yld3_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld3_row12)

summary(spa_sny23_yld3_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12 <- coef(spa_sny23_yld3_row12)$random
blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12
blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12[,1]
names(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12) <- rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row12)
g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

spa_sny23_yld3_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse) + ar1(Range),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld3_row34)

summary(spa_sny23_yld3_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row34 <- coef(spa_sny23_yld3_row34)$random

blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row34 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_spa_sny23_yld3_row34 <- blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row34[,1]
names(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row34) <- rownames(blup_spa_sny23_yld3_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: Spatial model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_spa_sny23_yld3 <- intersect(names(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12), names(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row34))

cor(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12[common_spa_sny23_yld3], g_spa_sny23_yld3_row34[common_spa_sny23_yld3])


### =========================================================
### 5. PEE MODEL
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 1 (Rows 1 + 2)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_sny23_yld3_row12 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_250,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld3_row12)

summary(pee_sny23_yld3_row12)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row12 <- coef(pee_sny23_yld3_row12)$random

blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row12 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row12[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row12)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row12[,1]
names(g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12) <- rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row12)
g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### Block 2 (Rows 3 + 4)
### ---------------------------------------------------------

pee_sny23_yld3_row34 <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1  + Rep + PEE_250,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = sny23_yld3_row34)

summary(pee_sny23_yld3_row34)$varcomp


### Extract BLUPs
blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row34 <- coef(pee_sny23_yld3_row34)$random

blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row34 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row34[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row34)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

g_pee_sny23_yld3_row34 <- blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row34[,1]
names(g_pee_sny23_yld3_row34) <- rownames(blup_pee_sny23_yld3_row34)



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### GEER: PEE model
### ---------------------------------------------------------

common_pee_sny23_yld3 <- intersect(names(g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12), names(g_pee_sny23_yld3_row34))

cor( g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12[common_pee_sny23_yld3], g_pee_sny23_yld3_row34[common_pee_sny23_yld3])




### =========================================================
### 6. Final GEER summary table
### =========================================================

GEER_rowblock_results_sny23_yld3 <- data.frame(

  Model = c("Base", "Spatial", "PEE"),

  Pearson = c(
    cor(g_base_sny23_yld3_row12[common_base_sny23_yld3],
        g_base_sny23_yld3_row34[common_base_sny23_yld3]),

    cor(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12[common_spa_sny23_yld3],
        g_spa_sny23_yld3_row34[common_spa_sny23_yld3]),

    cor(g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12[common_pee_sny23_yld3],
        g_pee_sny23_yld3_row34[common_pee_sny23_yld3])))

GEER_rowblock_results_sny23_yld3
```

```{r Validation of GEER results using all data base model, sny23 yld3, 05192026}

### =========================================================
### VALIDATION OF GEER RESULTS
### Snyder NY 2023
### Harvest 1 (yld3)
###
### Goal:
###   Compare genomic BLUPs from:
###     1. Base model using all data
###     2. Spatial model using each block
###     3. PEE model using each block
###
### Validation:
###   Correlate block-specific BLUPs against
###   baseline genomic BLUPs from full dataset
### =========================================================


### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Ensure inverse GRM
### ---------------------------------------------------------

asreml.options(extra = 200, maxit = 200)

attr(grm_inverse, "INVERSE") <- TRUE



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Create row-block subsets
### ---------------------------------------------------------

sny23_yld3_row12 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(1, 2))

sny23_yld3_row34 <- ny_sny_pheno_23 %>%
  filter(Row %in% c(3, 4))



### =========================================================
### 3. BASE MODEL USING ALL DATA
### =========================================================

sny23_yld3_base_all <- asreml(
  fixed    = yld3 ~ 1 + Rep,
  random   = ~ vm(Germplasm, grm_inverse),
  residual = ~ id(units),
  data     = ny_sny_pheno_23)

summary(sny23_yld3_base_all)$varcomp


### Extract genomic BLUPs
sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all <- coef(sny23_yld3_base_all)$random

sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all <- sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all[
  grep("Germplasm", rownames(sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE]

sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all <- sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all[,1]

names(sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all) <- 
  rownames(sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all)
sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all

##### part of spatial model and PEE model in above chunk...

### =========================================================
### 4. VALIDATION CORRELATIONS
### =========================================================

### Spatial correlations (Ar)
sny23_yld3_cor_spa <- c(
  cor(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row12, sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all),
  cor(g_spa_sny23_yld3_row34, sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all))

sny23_yld3_cor_spa



### PEE correlations
sny23_yld3_cor_pee <- c(
  cor(g_pee_sny23_yld3_row12, sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all),
  cor(
    g_pee_sny23_yld3_row34, sny23_yld3_gblup_base_all))
sny23_yld3_cor_pee



### =========================================================
### 5. Summary table
### =========================================================

sny23_yld3_validation_results <- data.frame(

  Model = c("Spatial_Row12",
            "Spatial_Row34",
            "PEE_Row12",
            "PEE_Row34"),

  Pearson = c(
    sny23_yld3_cor_spa[1],
    sny23_yld3_cor_spa[2],
    sny23_yld3_cor_pee[1],
    sny23_yld3_cor_pee[2]))

sny23_yld3_validation_results
```

#### PLOTS 
### 1. GEER for all harvest (Raw)

```{r GEER all harvests sny23, 05222026}
### =========================================================
### Boxplot of GEER across harvests
### Snyder NY 2023
### =========================================================

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 1. Create data frame
### ---------------------------------------------------------

GEER_sny23_allharvests <- data.frame(
  Harvest = c("Harvest1", "Harvest2", "Harvest3"),
  Base = c(0.52, 0.74, 0.66),
  Spatial = c(0.67, 0.72, 0.69),
  PEE = c(0.67, 0.73, 0.75))
GEER_sny23_allharvests



### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Convert to long format
### ---------------------------------------------------------

GEER_sny23_allharvests_long <- 
  GEER_sny23_allharvests %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Base, Spatial, PEE),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "GEER")

GEER_sny23_allharvests_long

### Set order of boxplots
GEER_sny23_allharvests_long$Model <- factor(
  GEER_sny23_allharvests_long$Model,
  levels = c("Base", "Spatial", "PEE"))

### ---------------------------------------------------------
### 3. Boxplot
### ---------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  GEER_sny23_allharvests_long,
  aes(x = Model,
      y = GEER,
      fill = Model)) +

  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +

  geom_point(
    color = "red",
    shape = 18,
    size = 2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.05)) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Base"    = "grey80",
    "Spatial" = "lightblue3",
    "PEE"     = "lightgreen")) +

  labs(
    title = "Snyder23 All Harvests: Model Comparison using GEER",
    x = "Model",
    y = "GEER (Pearson correlation)") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5),

    legend.position = "none")
```
